description: Removes a knowledge entry and EVERY version of it for good, live or already deleted: nothing can bring it back (delete_knowledge is the restorable way). Only an owner or an admin forgets a shared entry; a person's own Only for you note is forgotten by them alone. read_knowledge says whether the person may (rights.forgetForGood). Ask the person first and send confirm "forget for good" only once they said yes. The answer counts the versions removed.

confirm.description: Exactly "forget for good": the person's second yes, since nothing can be brought back.

knowledge_id.description: The entry (list_knowledge and search_knowledge give ids).

project_id.description: The project the entry is in. May be left out: the entry's id finds its own project or the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: forget_knowledge
title: Forget a knowledge entry for good
